card: Enables IPC testing in the 32-bit x86 (i686) continuous integration job. The i686 job previously explicitly disabled IPC to provide coverage for -DENABLE_IPC=OFF, leaving 32-bit IPC configurations untested in CI. Compiler ABI differences on 32-bit platforms have previously caused failures in libmultiprocess, making CI coverage desirable to catch regressions. The change affects only CI configuration.
changed_since_previous: Diff is now available; the implementation renames `ci/test/00_setup_env_i686_no_ipc.sh` to `00_setup_env_i686.sh` and updates the workflow job definition.
evidence: Commit message: "Exercise IPC on 32-bit x86, where compiler ABI differences have caused failures."
Description points to bitcoin-core/libmultiprocess#383 as an example of 32-bit ABI issues requiring coverage.
problem: The i686 CI job was arbitrarily chosen to test building with `-DENABLE_IPC=OFF`, leaving IPC functionality untested on 32-bit x86 where compiler ABI differences can cause failures.

risk.why: A mistake would only cause failures or misconfigurations in the i686 CI job.

summary: Enables IPC in the 32-bit x86 (i686) continuous integration job. It renames the CI environment setup script and drops the configuration flag that disabled IPC for that job.
